newsitem.title: INDIA: India HZL plans 170,500T zinc,lead output in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: India HZL plans 170,500T zinc,lead output in 97/98.

text.p: India's state-run Hindustan Zinc Ltd (HZL) said on Thursday it plans to produce 170,500 tonnes of zinc and lead in 1997/98 (April-March), an increase of about 22 percent over estimated output in 1996/97.
HZL said in a statement it envisaged zinc and lead sales of about 160,000 tonnes in 1997/98, a 25 percent increase over anticipated sales in 1996/97.
An agreement was signed between HZL and the Mines Ministry on Thursday on the output and sales targets, the statement said.
It said HZL will expand the mining capacity of its Rampura Agucha mine in the western state of Rajasthan to 4,500 tonnes per day in 1997/98 from the current 3,000 tonnes.
It will also expand its smelter capacity during 1997/98. The statement did not give details.
